001package models;
002
003import enums.LessonType;
004
005import java.io.Serializable;
006import java.time.LocalDateTime;
007
008/** Scheduled lesson belonging to a course and taught by a teacher. */
009public class Lesson implements Serializable {
010    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
011
012    private String lessonID;
013    private LessonType type;
014    private LocalDateTime dateTime;
015    private Course course;
016    private Teacher teacher;
017
018    public Lesson(String lessonID, LessonType type, LocalDateTime dateTime, Course course, Teacher teacher) {
019        this.lessonID = lessonID;
020        this.type = type;
021        this.dateTime = dateTime;
022        this.course = course;
023        this.teacher = teacher;
024    }
025
026    public LessonType getType() {
027        return type;
028    }
029
030    public String getLessonID() {
031        return lessonID;
032    }
033
034    public LocalDateTime getDateTime() {
035        return dateTime;
036    }
037
038    public Course getCourse() {
039        return course;
040    }
041
042    public Teacher getTeacher() {
043        return teacher;
044    }
045
046    @Override
047    public String toString() {
048        return "Lesson{" +
049                "lessonID='" + lessonID + '\'' +
050                ", type=" + type +
051                ", dateTime=" + dateTime +
052                ", course=" + (course == null ? "-" : course.getCourseID()) +
053                ", teacher=" + (teacher == null ? "-" : teacher.getLogin()) +
054                '}';
055    }
056}
